capabilities: drag task cards across kanban boards grouped by any property
show dashboard tiles, donut charts and burndown/velocity reports
plan and run sprints with backlog planning and sprint completion
display epics, stories and sub-tasks on a parent-linked timeline
record a vault-wide activity timeline with per-task history and heatmap
disambiguation: Not a favorite-notes bookmarker despite the name; it tracks tasks and sprints on Jira-style boards.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README includes manual install steps and mentions a Claude prompt for setup in a docs guide.
intentEvidence: The Star board is a fork of Base Board by Michael DeRazon (MIT)
problem: Obsidian's Bases gives table views over note metadata but no project tracking views like kanban boards, sprint planning, burndown charts or epic timelines.
